text:
Clara (Marketing): Request: compact benchmark hero + webinar frame for next Wed launch. Need credibility-forward visuals + social gif.
Noah (Design): list deliverables?
Clara (Marketing): hero static 1200x628, webinar frame 1920x1080 (title-safe 140px), 1:1 gif (1080x1080, ~3s loop, animated CTA), slide template (16:9 Figma). Lockups: left and centered.
Ada (Creative Ops): tag L10n (EN/FR/DE) and legal for benchmark claims. Provide figma source and export tokens.
ExportBot: export checklist: PNG@2x, SVG icons, GIF optimized (gifsicle --optimize=3). Contrast >=4.5:1, alt text required.
Hector (Growth): two CTAs for A/B: "See the numbers" / "Register now". Need animated CTA pulse for gif (3-frame loop).
Noah (Design): style: data-forward (sparklines + metric pills) + subtle mascot accent. Will mock by Tue EOD, final by Mon AM. Uploading to Figma when ready.
LegalBot: flagged for review: any specific numeric claims must reference bench-run-0426.
Ada (Creative Ops): note for L10n: leave extra horizontal padding for DE.
Clara (Marketing): timeline confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
